gallery.label: {name} campus gallery
gallery.title: Explore the University of Ruhuna in Pictures
gallery.subtitle: Authentic photographs of the iconic Wellamadama coastal campus, Geoffrey Bawa architecture, and specialized faculties.
gallery.photo1Desc: The main campus is perched on rolling coastal knolls overlooking the Indian Ocean along the Matara-Kataragama road.
gallery.photo2Desc: World-renowned red-tiled pavilions, natural rock outcrops, and shaded colonnades designed by legendary architect Geoffrey Bawa.
gallery.photo3Desc: Modern multi-tier engineering blocks nestled in the green hills of Hapugala.
gallery.photo4Desc: Covered walkways connecting hillsides with natural breeze channels and lush garden courtyards.
gallery.photo5Desc: State-of-the-art computing, telecommunications, and high-voltage laboratories.
gallery.attribution: Real photographs sourced via Wikimedia Commons & University of Ruhuna community (CC BY-SA 3.0).

universityDetail.motto: Paññayā Narānaṅ Ratanaṅ · Wisdom is man’s greatest treasure
universityDetail.taglineRuhuna: The Southern Province’s Premier National Seat of Higher Learning

heritage.title: Geoffrey Bawa’s Coastal Masterpiece
heritage.description: The Wellamadama main campus was master-planned by legendary Sri Lankan architect Geoffrey Bawa between 1980 and 1988, creating an internationally acclaimed masterpiece of Tropical Modernism.
heritage.bawaCard1Desc: Built on a 72-acre coastal topography across two hills and an artificial lake, Bawa preserved natural granite boulders and sea breezes rather than leveling the terrain.
heritage.bawaCard2Desc: Instead of monolithic concrete blocks, over fifty individual red-tiled pavilions are connected by covered stone verandas, courtyards, and open-air corridors.
heritage.tagoreDesc: Gifted through a grant from the Government of India, this 1,500-seat state-of-the-art facility is the largest auditorium in any Sri Lankan university, adhering gracefully to Bawa's Tropical Modernist aesthetic.

facultyExplorer.title: Explore Ruhuna’s 10 Specialized Faculties
facultyExplorer.description: Faculties are strategically located across the Southern Province in Matara, Galle, and Kamburupitiya to optimize clinical, marine, engineering, and agricultural education.

facilitiesSection.title: World-Class Facilities & Student Community
facilitiesSection.description: Beyond lectures, Ruhuna offers premier research infrastructure, oceanfront libraries, vibrant student societies, and athletic facilities.
facilitiesSection.tagoreFacilityDesc: 1,500-seat acoustic concert and convocation hall, the largest in any university across Sri Lanka.
facilitiesSection.libraryFacilityDesc: Over 200,000 volumes, e-journal databases, quiet study halls, and branch libraries in Galle and Mapalana.
facilitiesSection.sportsFacilityDesc: Indoor gymnasium, international-standard athletic track, cricket ground, badminton, and annual Colours Night.
facilitiesSection.marineFacilityDesc: Dedicated marine research vessels, oceanographic monitors, and coastal aquaculture hatcheries.
facilitiesSection.societiesFacilityDesc: IEEE Student Branch Ruhuna, AIESEC in Ruhuna, Rotaract, Arts Circle, Nature Club, and Explorers.
facilitiesSection.labsFacilityDesc: High-voltage test facilities, robotics suites, clean rooms, and data processing centers.

admissionsGuide.title: How to Enter the University of Ruhuna
admissionsGuide.description: A practical roadmap for Sri Lankan G.C.E. O/L and A/L students aiming for national university admission.
admissionsGuide.step1Title: 1. Choose the Right G.C.E. A/L Stream
admissionsGuide.step1Desc: Engineering requires Physical Science (Combined Maths, Physics, Chemistry/ICT). Medicine and Allied Health require Biological Science. Technology requires ET/BST. Management and Humanities require Commerce and Arts.
admissionsGuide.step2Desc: Selection is administered nationally by the University Grants Commission (UGC) via 40% All-Island Merit and 60% District Quota (including 5% for underprivileged districts).
admissionsGuide.step3Desc: Certain degrees (e.g. Computer Science, Marine Information Technology) may require an aptitude test or minimum O/L English grade as published in the annual UGC handbook.

about.title: Built for your journey.
about.intro:
A career and education guidance space created by an engineering student,

for Sri Lankan students figuring out what comes next.

note.title: From someone who has been in your shoes
note.body:
The big decisions feel easier when an aiya shares the roadmap.

That is the feeling I want SkillBridge SL to give every student.

story.title: Why I started SkillBridge SL
story.description: A small student idea, with a bigger purpose.
story.hi: Hi, I’m the student behind SkillBridge SL.
story.p1:
I study at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Ruhuna. I know how hard

it can be to connect school subjects, degree choices and real careers.
story.p2:
I created SkillBridge SL to bring that information into one friendly place—

so the next student does not have to figure everything out alone.
story.tag: Made by a Ruhuna engineering student
